# The Sector Today
The [textlink="Quick Timeline" link="Timeline"] ends with a ceasefire. It did not stay quiet for long.
## The cold war
The [color=cyan]TSF[/color] and the [color=orange]Vanguard[/color] still face each other across the sector, guns loaded and safeties on. War comes only when both the Colonel and the Grand Vizier declare it. Until then they fight by proxy: smuggling runs, contested drop pods, Monolithic Fragments, and long looks across the docking ring at [textlink="Caelestinus Central" link="Caelestinus"].
## The Collapse
Kyphrus, the sector's sun, is gone. In its place hangs a black hole ringed by a bright accretion disk. [textlink="The Collapse" link="WFLoreCollapse"] changed every world in the system, and opened some of them to landing for the first time.
## New powers, old machines
- The [textlink="Ashfall Reavers" link="WFLoreReavers"] grew out of the people the sector broke. They now hold strongholds and raid anyone too weak to shoot back. - The [textlink="Automated Defense System" link="WFLoreAds"] woke. Its derelict hulls hold ground in the dark and query every ship that passes. - The [textlink="Astraeus Solar Federation" link="WFAsf"] keeps an envoy post on the sector's edge, watching and taking notes. - The [textlink="judges of Caelestinus Central" link="WFLoreJudges"] fly patrol around the station so the traders keep coming.
## Things that should not be
Black stones that give power for nothing. Flesh that walks after it dies. Hives under alien soil. See [textlink="Things That Hunt" link="WFLoreThreats"].
